headline: Aurobindo Pharma Limited: Amalgamation/Merger
sum: Amalgamation/Merger - Aurobindo Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about Amalgamation/Merger of Auroactive Pharma Private Limited with Apitoria Pharma Private Limited wholly owned subsidiaries of the Company.
